mapper.sql: job_id, user_id, user_name, sql_content, engine_type, engine_instance, engine_params, executor_instance, status, cancel_requested, cancel_requested_time, processing_server_instance, client_ip, client_user_agent, client_request_id, source_file_node_id, submit_time, validate_finish_time, dispatch_time, split_finish_time, start_time, finish_time, duration_ms, persistent_log_path, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE adhoc_query_job SET status='DISPATCHING', processing_server_instance=#{serverInstanceId}, dispatch_time=#{dispatchTime} WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE adhoc_query_job SET status='PENDING', processing_server_instance=NULL, dispatch_time=NULL WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status='DISPATCHING'
UPDATE adhoc_query_job SET status='FAILED', finish_time=NOW() WHERE executor_instance=#{exec} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE adhoc_query_job SET processing_server_instance=NULL WHERE status='RUNNING' AND processing_server_instance IN (SELECT instance_id FROM adhoc_server_instance WHERE status='DOWN')

UPDATE adhoc_query_job SET status='PENDING', processing_server_instance=NULL, dispatch_time=NULL WHERE status='DISPATCHING' AND processing_server_instance IN (SELECT instance_id FROM adhoc_server_instance WHERE status='DOWN')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' AND fail_reason_category = 'SKIPPED_DUE_TO_PRIOR_FAILURE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skipped FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submit_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT engine_type AS engineType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submit_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY engine_type

SELECT hour AS hour, SUM(isSubmitted) AS submitted, SUM(isFinished) AS finished FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') AS hour, 1 AS isSubmitted, 0 AS isFinished FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submit_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00'), 0, 1 FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE finish_time >= #{startTime} AND finish_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','PARTIAL_FAILED','CANCELED') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00'), 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00'), 0, 0 ) t WHERE hour IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

SELECT hour AS hour, SUM(isSubmitted) AS submitted, SUM(isFinished) AS finished FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS hour, 1 AS isSubmitted, 0 AS isFinished FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submit_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), 0, 1 FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE finish_time >= #{startTime} AND finish_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','PARTIAL_FAILED','CANCELED') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d'), 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d'), 0, 0 ) t WHERE hour IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

SELECT IFNULL(AVG(dur), 0) AS avgMs, IFNULL(MAX(dur), 0) AS maxMs, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN dur < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket0to1s, SUM(CASE WHEN dur >= 1000 AND dur < 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket1to10s, SUM(CASE WHEN dur >= 10000 AND dur < 60000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket10to60s, SUM(CASE WHEN dur >= 60000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucketGt60s FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(duration_ms, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, submit_time, finish_time) DIV 1000) AS dur FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submit_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 AND finish_time IS NOT NULL ) t

SELECT job_id AS jobId, user_id AS userId, user_name AS userName, engine_type AS engineType, status AS status, COALESCE(duration_ms, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, submit_time, finish_time) DIV 1000) AS durationMs, submit_time AS submitTime FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submit_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 AND finish_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(duration_ms, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, submit_time, finish_time) DIV 1000) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT user_id AS userId, user_name AS userName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submit_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY user_id, user_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT processing_server_instance AS serverInstance, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = 0 AND processing_server_instance IS NOT NULL GROUP BY processing_server_instance
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING','DISPATCHING','RUNNING') AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT COALESCE(processing_server_instance, '(未分配)') AS instance, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submit_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY processing_server_instance

SELECT COALESCE(executor_instance, '(未分配)') AS instance, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_job WHERE submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submit_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY executor_instance
